assessments.title: Call swapUSDSToUSDC Function
assessments.description: Restricts USDS to USDC swaps via the PSM to authorized relayers within specified rate limits.
assessments.quote:
Only an operator with the relayer role can swap USDS to USDC via the PSM. To do so, they must call the `swapUSDSToUSDC` function on the Controller contract on mainnet, providing the usdcAmount (denominated in 1e6 precision to match PSM USDC handling). The operation will only succeed if the ALM Proxy holds at least the equivalent amount of USDS for the swap; otherwise, the transaction will revert. The rate limit configuration serves as whitelisting for swaps. Calling this function will carry out the following actions:

- The contract will confirm the relayer status of the operator. If the caller does not have the relayer role, the transaction will revert.
- The contract will ensure the swap amount is within the allowed rate limit (LIMIT_USDS_TO_USDC) for the PSM.
- The contract will convert the USDC amount to an 18-decimal format using psmTo18ConversionFactor.
- The contract will approve the daiUsds contract to spend the converted amount from the ALM Proxy.
- The contract will swap USDS to Dai at a 1:1 ratio via daiUsds, sending Dai to the proxy.
- The contract will approve the PSM to spend the Dai.
- The contract will swap Dai to USDC at a 1:1 ratio with no fee via psm.buyGemNoFee, sending USDC to the proxy.

The function call is as follows:

`function swapUSDSToUSDC(uint256 usdcAmount) external`
assessments.precisenessReasoning: The rule specifies the exact function, required role, and revert conditions (relayer check, rate limit, balance). The rate limit parameter LIMIT_USDS_TO_USDC is named but its numeric value is not stated, leaving a minor gap in full quantification.
assessments.enforcementReasoning: The function is part of the Peg Stability Module (PSM), which enforces the swap conditions on-chain; any violation causes the transaction to revert automatically, making non-compliance impossible.

assessments.title: Call swapUSDCToUSDS Function
assessments.description: Defines the operational requirements and logic for relayer-initiated USDC to USDS swaps via the PSM.
assessments.quote:
Only an operator with the relayer role can swap USDC to USDS via the PSM. To do so, they must call the `swapUSDCToUSDS` function on the Controller contract on mainnet, providing the usdcAmount (denominated in 1e6 precision to match PSM USDC handling). The operation will only succeed if the ALM Proxy holds at least the amount of USDC specified for the swap; otherwise, the transaction will revert. The rate limit configuration serves as whitelisting for swaps. Calling this function will carry out the following actions:

- The contract will confirm the relayer status of the operator. If the caller does not have the relayer role, the transaction will revert.
- The contract will ensure the swap amount is within the allowed rate limit (LIMIT_USDC_TO_USDS) for the PSM.
- The contract will approve the PSM to spend the USDC from the ALM Proxy.
- The contract will calculate the swap limit per transaction based on the Dai balance held by the PSM, converting with psmTo18ConversionFactor.
- If the usdcAmount is less than or equal to the limit, the contract will perform a direct swap of USDC to Dai.
- If the usdcAmount exceeds the limit, the contract will split the swap into multiple smaller swaps: refill the PSM with Dai via psm.fill, recalculate the limit, swap the maximum allowed amount, update the remaining amount, and repeat until complete (reverting with "DssLitePsm/nothing-to-fill" if PSM cannot be filled).
- The contract will convert the USDC amount to a Dai amount, accounting for token decimal differences.
- The contract will approve the daiUsds contract to spend the Dai amount from the ALM Proxy.
- The contract will swap Dai to USDS at a 1:1 ratio via daiUsds, sending USDS to the proxy.

The function call is as follows:

`function swapUSDCToUSDS(uint256 usdcAmount) external`
assessments.precisenessReasoning: The rule specifies exact function name, contract, required role, input parameter (usdcAmount with precision), and a complete sequence of on-chain checks and actions with explicit revert conditions. All conditions are objectively verifiable from the transaction and contract state.
metrics: Dai balance held by the PSM
assessments.enforcementReasoning: The rule is enforced automatically by the Controller and PSM smart contracts: any call that fails the relayer check, rate limit, or balance requirement reverts on-chain. This is a direct on-chain enforcement of the swap logic, consistent with the Peg Stability Module mechanism.

assessments.title: Remove Compromised Actor As Freezer
assessments.description: The Freezer Multisig may remove a compromised Actor by calling removeActor on the AdministeredAgent contract.
assessments.quote: In the event of a compromised or malicious Actor, the Freezer Multisig — registered as a Revoker on the AdministeredAgent, as specified in [A.2.2.10.1.1.1.3.5 - Revoker](cc7cb4b7-981e-44f5-a0d5-62e5b47d112e) — removes that Actor by calling `removeActor` on the AdministeredAgent contract. Removing the Actor prevents it from submitting further operations, while the Allocator Role itself remains with the AdministeredAgent. This action should only be taken if a Relayer Multisig's keys have been leaked or compromised and the Actor is in the control of an external bad actor.
assessments.precisenessReasoning: The rule specifies exactly who acts (Freezer Multisig), the specific function call (`removeActor`), on which contract (AdministeredAgent), and the precise triggering condition (a compromised or malicious Actor with leaked/compromised keys). A third party can verify compliance from the text alone.
assessments.enforcementReasoning: The action is an on-chain contract call by a designated multisig, making it self-executing. Failure or inability to execute this critical security response constitutes a security violation explicitly covered by the pre-authorized Emergency Spells (b8266c11) and Emergency Response System (1d940c6d).

assessments.title: Withdraw All SparkLend Positions
assessments.description: Allows a Relayer Multisig to withdraw all SparkLend USDS positions via the Aave v3 Facet.
assessments.quote: In the event that liquidity must be recovered from SparkLend and centralized in the Osero ALM Proxy, a Relayer Multisig, acting as an Actor, withdraws the Osero Liquidity Layer's full SparkLend USDS position through the Aave v3 Facet, as specified in [A.2.2.10.1.1.1.5.2.2.2 - Withdraw From Aave v3 Market](038eaa5c-d4c0-4a56-8d30-bc3a04508f0e). SparkLend withdrawals are unlimited so that the full position can be unwound.
assessments.precisenessReasoning: The rule names a specific actor (Relayer Multisig), action (withdraw via Aave v3 Facet), and amount (full SparkLend USDS position; withdrawals unlimited), but the triggering condition 'liquidity must be recovered' is qualitative and the procedure is delegated to a referenced document, with no numeric threshold or deadline.
assessments.enforcementReasoning: As a Prime Agent artifact, this action could be reviewed by Core GovOps under the Agent Artifact Review mechanism, which includes published findings and penalty assessment by an enforcer distinct from the actor. No quantified consequence is stated for this specific rule, so the mechanism is general rather than strong.

assessments.quote: The in progress Invocations of the Risk Capital Rental Primitive are contained herein. Once an Invocation is successfully completed, its subtree will be moved to [A.6.1.1.7.2.6.2.2 - Active Instances](d48fecab-0528-4d96-b760-49ca8568be85).
assessments.precisenessReasoning: The rule describes a process (moving completed invocations) but 'successfully completed' is undefined, no metrics, thresholds, or verifiable conditions; compliance is arguable.
